identity.title: Prospective identical-response exact-response replication (TASK 070)
identity.research_question: paired source-task-group disagreement: for each task group, whether the distribution-aware decision differs from the chosen-token decision derived from the same immutable completion

hypotheses.primary_null: Distribution-aware and chosen-token decisions agree on every paired source task group; the paired disagreement rate is zero.
hypotheses.primary_alternative: The paired source-task-group disagreement rate between distribution-aware and chosen-token decisions exceeds zero by the prespecified margin detectable at the locked design.

datasets.source: controlled-corruption-v3 governed release (Terminal-Bench 2 + SWE-bench public traces)
datasets.license: Apache-2.0 (60 groups) / MIT (40 groups), reference_only redistribution

primary.question: non_inferiority
primary.failure_denominator: all eligible task groups including invalid, missing, abstained, and route-failed

failures.missing_score: count in denominator as missing; never imputed
failures.provider_failure: retry up to hard attempt budget; persistent failure counts in denominator
failures.route_failure: counts in denominator; route attestation invalidates remaining calls
failures.timeout: counts as provider failure after retry exhaustion
failures.abstention: first-class outcome; reported separately in denominator
failures.budget_exhaustion: study stops; partial cells reported as failed with denominators
failures.retry_exhaustion: cell fails closed into the denominator
failures.incomplete_cell: reported as failed cell; no imputation or pooling
failures.denominator_policy: invalid, missing, abstention, and route-failure task groups remain in the denominator and are never imputed, dropped, or replaced by majority vote

adjudication.blinding: verifier performance withheld from any human review
adjudication.conflict_resolution: prespecified tie-break: distribution-aware arm wins ties only when score mass difference exceeds declared threshold
adjudication.label_revision: none post-lock; revisions create a new study ID
